Coursebook MUNDARIJASINING chap beti. Bosilgan bet raqami: 2.

Mundarija IKKI BETLIK YOYMA:
  2-bet (bu bet) — GRAMMAR, VOCABULARY, READING ustunlari
  3-bet — LISTENING & SPEAKING, COMMUNICATION, WRITING ustunlari

Chap chekkada vertikal ravishda modul raqamlari: MODULE 1, MODULE 2, MODULE 3, MODULE 4.

Har unit o'z rangida bo'yalgan qator: ko'k, pushti, yashil, binafsha, sariq.

⚠⚠ MUHIM TASDIQ — MODULLAR TARKIBI:
  MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT 1 — UNITS 1, 2, 3, 4
  MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT 2 — UNITS 5, 6, 7, 8
  MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT 3 — UNITS 9, 10, 11, 12
  MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT 4 — UNITS 13, 14, 15

Ya'ni 4-modulda UChTA unit bor. Bu orqa muqovadagi 'four modules of four units each' da'vosining noto'g'ri ekanini yana bir bor tasdiqlaydi.

⚠⚠ MUNDARIJADA WORD LIST YO'Q: pastki ro'yxatda IRREGULAR VERBS (116-bet), PHOTO FILE SECTION, CULTURE CLIPS (153-163), AMERICAN ENGLISH-BRITISH ENGLISH GUIDE (164-166) bor, LEKIN 119-124-betlardagi WORD LIST ro'yxatga KIRITILMAGAN. Kesib kattalashtirib tekshirdim.

⚠ FOYDALI TASDIQ: 'CULTURE CLIPS (pp. 153-163)' — demak Culture Clips bo'limining muqovasi (raqam bosilmagan bet) aynan 153-bet. Bizning p145 fayli aynan shu bet.

⚠ 'PHOTO FILE SECTION' yonida bet raqami YO'Q — bu bo'lim varaqlari raqamlanmagani uchun. Bu ham bizning kuzatuvimizni tasdiqlaydi.

⚠ IMLO TASDIG'I: bu yerda '14-UNIT: Dos and Don'ts' TO'G'RI yozilgan (oddiy apostrof bilan). Workbook mundarijasida esa 'Dos and Don´ts' — o'tkir urg'u belgisi bilan xato yozilgan edi.

exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — MUNDARIJANING ChAP BETI.

  Mundarija IKKI BETLIK YOYMA:
     2-bet — GRAMMAR, VOCABULARY,
             READING
     3-bet — LISTENING & SPEAKING,
             COMMUNICATION, WRITING


TO'LIQ MUNDARIJA (2-bet):

─── MODULE 1 ───────────────────

  UNIT 1  Hi!  (6-11)
     G: a - an; the verb 'to be'
     V: countries & nationalities;
        ordinal/cardinal numbers; jobs
     R: introducing people

  UNIT 2  A Friend in Need...  (12-17)
     G: the verb 'have (got)';
        the verb 'can' (ability, polite
        requests)
     V: people's appearances; abilities;
        colours
     R: Internet advertisements for
        pen-friends; Culture Point -
        people around the world

  UNIT 3  Home Sweet Home  (18-23)
     G: there is/there are;
        this/these - that/those;
        plurals (-s, -es);
        prepositions of place
     V: houses/homes; furniture &
        appliances
     R: advertisements for houses;
        Culture Point - houses around
        the world

  STORY 1: THE LOCH NESS MONSTER -
     EPISODE 1: THE ACCIDENT  (24-25)

  UNIT 4  Like Father, like Son  (26-31)
     G: possessive case; possessive
        adjectives/pronouns;
        whose/who's; present simple
     V: family relationships; free-time
        activities; days of the week
     R: letters to pen-friends

  MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT 1 -
     UNITS 1, 2, 3, 4  (32-33)

─── MODULE 2 ───────────────────

  UNIT 5  An Early Bird or a Night Owl?
     (34-39)
     G: adverbs of frequency;
        prepositions of time (at, in, on)
     V: daily routines; telling the time;
        months; pros/cons of jobs
     R: article about a person's daily
        routine; Culture Point -
        opening hours in Holland

  UNIT 6  Birds of a Feather  (40-45)
     G: question words; irregular nouns
     V: describing animals; colours;
        sizes
     R: facts about animals

  STORY 1: THE LOCH NESS MONSTER -
     EPISODE 2: THE WRONG PHOTOGRAPH
     (46-47)

  UNIT 7  Come Rain or Shine  (48-53)
     G: present continuous;
        present continuous vs
        present simple
     V: weather conditions/climate;
        clothes
     R: postcards to friends while on
        holiday; Culture Point -
        weather in various countries

  UNIT 8  Enjoy your Meal  (54-59)
     G: plurals; countable/uncountable
        nouns; a/an/some;
        how much/how many;
        a few/a little; some/any
     V: types of food/drinks; meals;
        restaurants
     R: advertisement for a restaurant;
        Culture Point - eating habits in
        various countries

  MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT 2 -
     UNITS 5, 6, 7, 8  (60-61)

─── MODULE 3 ───────────────────

  UNIT 9  Times Change...  (62-67)
     G: was/were, had, could;
        prepositions of place
     V: places/buildings in a town;
        giving directions; abilities
     R: article about a place then and
        now; Culture Point - life in
        ancient Rome

  STORY 2: THE EXPEDITION -
     EPISODE 1: THE WATERFALL  (68-69)

  UNIT 10  The Price of Fame  (70-75)
     G: past simple; asking questions
     V: famous people and their
        achievements; full dates
     R: Diana Spencer (biography);
        Backstreet Boys

  UNIT 11  All's Well that Ends Well
     (76-81)
     G: past simple; joining sentences;
        prepositions of movement;
        adjectives/adverbs
     V: feelings & reactions;
        danger & emergencies
     R: a story; Culture Point -
        a folk tale from Holland

  UNIT 12  See New Places, Meet New
     Faces  (82-87)
     G: comparisons; quite, too, very,
        much
     V: towns/cities; transport;
        holidays
     R: article about LA; Culture Point -
        Stratford-upon-Avon

  STORY 2: THE EXPEDITION -
     EPISODE 2: THE JIVARO INDIANS
     (88-89)

  MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT 3 -
     UNITS 9, 10, 11, 12  (90-91)

─── MODULE 4 ───────────────────

  UNIT 13  Time will Tell  (92-97)
     G: be going to; will;
        present continuous (future
        meaning); it/there will be
     V: future plans/intentions;
        arrangements; future predictions
     R: letter to a friend about summer
        plans; horoscopes

  UNIT 14  Dos and Don'ts  (98-103)
     G: should/shouldn't (advice),
        must (obligation),
        mustn't (prohibition),
        can (giving permission),
        can't (refusing permission)
     V: the environment; health tips;
        house rules/school rules
     R: leaflet giving advice on how to
        protect the environment;
        Culture Point - tips for
        travellers

  UNIT 15  Take a Break  (104-109)
     G: present perfect;
        revision of all tenses
     V: holidays/sightseeing;
        describing a city
     R: letter to a friend; Culture
        Point - tipping in America

  STORY 3: STRANGE VISITORS  (110-113)

  MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT 4 -
     UNITS 13, 14, 15  (114-115)

─── OXIRGI BO'LIMLAR ───────────

  IRREGULAR VERBS  (116)
  PHOTO FILE SECTION  (bet raqami yo'q)
  CULTURE CLIPS  (153-163)
  AMERICAN ENGLISH-BRITISH ENGLISH
     GUIDE  (164-166)


⚠⚠ MUNDARIJADA WORD LIST YO'Q!

  Pastki ro'yxatda to'rtta bo'lim
  sanalgan, LEKIN 119-124-betlardagi
  WORD LIST ro'yxatga KIRITILMAGAN.

  ⚠ Buni kesib kattalashtirib tekshirdim —
  haqiqatan yo'q.

  ⚠ Ya'ni o'quvchi mundarijaga qarab
  Word List borligini bilmaydi.


⚠⚠ MODULLAR TARKIBI TASDIQLANDI:

     Module 1 = Units 1, 2, 3, 4
     Module 2 = Units 5, 6, 7, 8
     Module 3 = Units 9, 10, 11, 12
     Module 4 = Units 13, 14, 15  ← 3 ta

  ⚠ Bu orqa muqovadagi
  'four modules of FOUR UNITS EACH'
  da'vosining noto'g'ri ekanini yana bir
  bor tasdiqlaydi. Kitobda 15 unit bor,
  16 emas.


⚠ FOYDALI TASDIQ — 153-BET:

  'CULTURE CLIPS (pp. 153-163)'

  ⚠ Demak Culture Clips muqovasi (bet
  raqami bosilmagan sahifa) aynan
  153-bet.

  ⚠ 'PHOTO FILE SECTION' yonida esa bet
  raqami YO'Q — chunki u varaqlar
  raqamlanmagan (qirqib olinadi).


⚠⚠ QIZIQ NARSA — UNIT NOMLARI IBORALAR!

  Deyarli har unit nomi — ingliz IBORASI
  yoki MAQOLI:

  'A Friend in Need...'
     to'liq maqol: 'A friend in need is
     a friend indeed.'
     = Do'st boshga kun tushganda bilinadi.

  'Home Sweet Home'
     = Uyginam, shirin uyginam.
     (Uydan yaxshi joy yo'q.)

  'Like Father, like Son'
     = Otasiga o'xshaydi.
     (Olma daraxtidan uzoqqa tushmaydi.)

  'An Early Bird or a Night Owl?'
     'an early bird' = erta turadigan odam
     'a night owl' = kechasi uxlamaydigan
        odam
     ⚠ 'The early bird catches the worm.'

  'Birds of a Feather'
     to'liq maqol: 'Birds of a feather
     flock together.'
     = Bir xil odamlar birga bo'ladi.
     ⚠ Unit HAYVONLAR haqida — so'z o'yini!

  'Come Rain or Shine'
     = Yomg'ir yog'sa ham, quyosh chiqsa ham
     (= har qanday sharoitda)
     ⚠ Unit OB-HAVO haqida — yana so'z o'yini!

  'All's Well that Ends Well'
     = Oxiri yaxshi bo'lsa, hammasi yaxshi.
     ⚠ Shekspir pyesasining nomi ham.

  'Time will Tell'
     = Vaqt ko'rsatadi.
     ⚠ Unit KELASI ZAMON haqida!

  'Dos and Don'ts'
     = Qilish va qilmaslik kerak bo'lgan
       narsalar
     ⚠ Unit 'should/must/mustn't' haqida!

  'Take a Break'
     = Dam olmoq, tanaffus qilmoq
     ⚠ Unit TA'TIL haqida!

  ⚠ Ya'ni sarlavhalar unit MAVZUSI bilan
  so'z o'yini orqali bog'langan. Bu —
  kitobning chiroyli dizayn yechimi.


⚠ IMLO TASDIG'I:

  Bu yerda '14-UNIT: Dos and Don'ts'
  TO'G'RI yozilgan (oddiy apostrof bilan).

  ⚠ Workbook mundarijasida esa
  'Dos and Don´ts' — O'TKIR URG'U belgisi
  bilan XATO yozilgan edi.

  ⚠ Ya'ni xato faqat Workbook'da.


⚠ 'CULTURE POINT' NIMA:

  Ko'p unitlarda 'Culture Point' bor —
  bu O'QISh matnining ichidagi kichik
  madaniy izoh.

  ⚠ Bu 154-163-betlardagi katta 'CULTURE
  CLIPS' bo'limidan BOShQA narsa.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  contents      = mundarija
  a module      = modul, bo'lim
  self-assessment = o'z-o'zini baholash
  an appliance  = maishiy texnika
  an achievement = yutuq
  a prediction  = bashorat
  an intention  = niyat
  an arrangement = kelishuv, reja
  obligation    = majburiyat
  prohibition   = taqiq
  permission    = ruxsat
  the environment = atrof-muhit
  a leaflet     = varaqcha
  revision      = takrorlash
  a folk tale   = xalq ertagi
  tipping       = choychaqa berish

exercises.instructionEn: Match each unit number to its title.
exercises.instructionUz: Har bir unit raqamini o'z nomi bilan moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
15 TA UNIT NOMI.

  ⚠ Bu mashq kitobda yo'q — mundarijani
  o'zlashtirish uchun qo'shildi.


⚠ Deyarli har nom — IBORA yoki MAQOL,
va unit mavzusi bilan SO'Z O'YINI orqali
bog'langan.

  Masalan:
     6-unit 'Birds of a Feather' —
        unit HAYVONLAR haqida
     7-unit 'Come Rain or Shine' —
        unit OB-HAVO haqida
     13-unit 'Time will Tell' —
        unit KELASI ZAMON haqida


⚠ IBORANI SO'ZMA-SO'Z TARJIMA QILMANG!

  'Home Sweet Home' — 'Uy shirin uy' EMAS,
  'Uydan yaxshi joy yo'q' degani.

  ⚠ Iboraning ma'nosi uning so'zlari
  yig'indisiga TENG EMAS.

pairs.whyUz:
Mavzu: tanishtirish, mamlakatlar va
millatlar, kasblar, sonlar.

Grammatika: 'a - an'; 'to be' fe'li.

⚠ 'Hi!' — norasmiy salomlashuv
('Hello' dan erkinroq).

⚠ TO'LIQ MAQOL: 'A friend in NEED is a
friend INDEED.'
= Do'st boshga kun tushganda bilinadi.

⚠ Kitob maqolning faqat YARMINI bergan va
uch nuqta qo'ygan — o'quvchi davomini
o'ylab ko'rsin degani.

Mavzu: tashqi ko'rinish, qobiliyatlar.

⚠ Mashhur ibora: uydan yaxshi joy yo'q
degani.

⚠ SO'ZMA-SO'Z tarjima qilmang!

Mavzu: uy, xonalar, mebel.
Grammatika: 'there is/there are', joy
predloglari.

⚠ Photo File 3-unit varag'idagi Paulaning xati shu unitga
tegishli.

⚠ Maqol: o'g'il otasiga o'xshaydi.
O'zbekchada: 'Olma daraxtidan uzoqqa
tushmaydi.'

⚠ 'like' bu yerda 'KABI' ma'nosida
(yoqtirmoq EMAS).

Mavzu: oila a'zolari, hafta kunlari.
Grammatika: egalik, Present Simple.

pairs.right: An Early Bird or a Night Owl?
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'an early bird' = erta turadigan odam
⚠ 'a night owl' = kechasi uxlamaydigan odam
('an owl' = boyqush)

⚠ Maqol: 'The early bird catches the worm.'
= Erta turgan omadga erishadi.

Mavzu: kun tartibi, soat.
⚠ Photo File 5-unit varag'idagi Anni Franklin varag'i shu
unitga tegishli.

⚠ TO'LIQ MAQOL: 'Birds of a feather FLOCK
TOGETHER.'
= Bir xil odamlar birga bo'ladi.

⚠⚠ SO'Z O'YINI: unit HAYVONLAR haqida,
nom esa QUSHLAR haqidagi maqol!

⚠ Photo File 6-unit varag'idagi hayvonlar varag'i shu unitga
tegishli.

pairs.rightUz: Yomg'ir yog'sa ham, quyosh chiqsa ham
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Ibora: har qanday sharoitda, nima
bo'lganda ham.

⚠⚠ SO'Z O'YINI: unit OB-HAVO haqida, ibora
esa ob-havo so'zlaridan tuzilgan!

Grammatika: Present Continuous.

⚠ Photo File 8-unit yozish varag'idagi restoran taqrizining oxirida
ham shu ibora bor edi!

Mavzu: ovqat, ichimlik, restoran.
Grammatika: sanaladigan/sanalmaydigan otlar,
'how much/how many'.

⚠ Photo File 8-unit varag'idagi ovqat varag'i shu unitga
tegishli.

⚠ 'times' bu yerda KO'PLIKDA — 'zamon,
davr' ma'nosida.

Mavzu: shahardagi binolar, yo'l ko'rsatish.
Grammatika: 'was/were', 'had', 'could'.

⚠ O'tgan zamon boshlanadigan unit —
shuning uchun nom ham o'tmish haqida.

⚠ Ibora: mashhurlikning o'z 'to'lovi' bor.

Mavzu: mashhur odamlar va ularning yutuqlari,
to'liq sanalar.
Grammatika: Past Simple, savol berish.

⚠ O'qish matnlari: Diana Spenser va
Backstreet Boys.

⚠ Maqol. Shekspirning pyesa nomi ham.

⚠ 'All's' = 'All is' qisqartmasi.
⚠ Birinchi 'well' = yaxshi (sifat);
ikkinchisi = tugaydi (fe'l bilan).

⚠ 155-betda 'well' ning uch ma'nosini
ko'rganmiz (quduq ham!).

Mavzu: his-tuyg'ular, xavf va favqulodda
vaziyatlar.

pairs.right: See New Places, Meet New Faces
pairs.rightUz: Yangi joylarni ko'r, yangi odamlar bilan tanish
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ QOFIYA: 'places' - 'faces'.

⚠ Ikkala qism ham BUYRUQ GAPI.

Mavzu: shaharlar, transport, ta'til.
Grammatika: taqqoslash, 'quite/too/very/much'.

⚠ Photo File 12-unit varag'idagi Antverpen varag'i shu unitga
tegishli.

⚠ Ibora: kelajakda ma'lum bo'ladi.

⚠⚠ SO'Z O'YINI: unit KELASI ZAMON haqida
('will'), nom esa aynan 'will' bilan
tuzilgan!

Mavzu: kelajak rejalari, bashoratlar.

⚠ Photo File 13-unit varag'idagi munajjimlar bashorati varag'i
shu unitga tegishli.

pairs.rightUz: Qilish va qilmaslik kerak bo'lgan narsalar
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Ibora: qoidalar ro'yxati.

⚠⚠ SO'Z O'YINI: unit 'should/must/mustn't'
haqida — ya'ni QOIDALAR haqida!

⚠ 'Dos' — 'do' ning ko'pligi (apostrofsiz);
'Don'ts' — 'don't' ning ko'pligi.

⚠ Photo File 14-unit varag'idagi Klara xolaning maslahat xati
shu unitga tegishli.

⚠ Ibora: tanaffus qilmoq, dam olmoq.

⚠⚠ SO'Z O'YINI: unit TA'TIL haqida!

⚠ 'to take a break' — 158-betdagi choy
matnida ham bor edi: 'they took a break'.

Grammatika: Present Perfect, barcha
zamonlarni takrorlash.

patterns.exampleEn: In Unit 15 we learn the present perfect.
